channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Sweden expels Iran embassy employee, citing security concerns
item.description: Stockholm says Iran-backed groups are plotting against 'Jewish and Israeli interests' in the country.

item.title: Ex-Trump ally Marjorie Taylor Greene says war on Iran must ‘stop’
item.description: Former Republican Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene slammed US President Donald Trump’s war on Iran.

item.title: Israeli ‘double-tap’ air strike responsible for killing schoolboy in Gaza
item.description: Two people were killed in the assault on Gaza City - a paramedic and a 15-year-old boy returning from school.

item.title: Iran war has cost the US $38bn: How will it impact US economy, politics?
item.description: High energy costs at the pump and strategic setback for US in the Iran war will likely cost Trump in the midterms.

item.title: Mahsa Amini death four years on: Iranians reflect on ‘Woman, Life, Freedom’
item.description: Amnesty International says Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during the 2022-23 protests.

item.title: Djibouti on alert as people flee Yemen after Houthi takeover of Mayyun
item.description: From aboard a Djiboutian naval vessel in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, an Al Jazeera team is monitoring the situation.

item.title: Gold mine collapse kills at least 70 people in Sudan’s West Kordofan
item.description: Dozens of artisanal miners have been killed after a series of adjoining mining shafts collapsed.

item.title: China willing to ‘safeguard Iran’s legitimate rights’, official says
item.description: China says the US-Israel war on Iran highlights flaws in the Middle East's 'existing security architecture'.

item.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
item.description: Dozens of people are missing beneath the rubble of a building hit by an Israeli strike last year, where some 10 families had been living.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
item.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".
